name: Murderer VS Sheriff
desc:
Welcome to Murderer VS Sheriff!

A dueling game where precision and strategy are required. Challenge others to duels, improve your skills, and rise to the top of the leaderboard.

💡 How to Play:
- Challenge others to duels.
- Improve your skills and stats.
- Be among the first on the leaderboard. 🎌

Any method of cheating will result in a permanent ban ⚠️

👍 Click "Like" if you like the game.
